description: Reference held-out evaluation results for Secret Leak Detector. Reproduce with 'npm run benchmark:heldout'. Labels are author-assigned and have not been independently reviewed.

methodology.corpusSeparation: This corpus was created after the detector rules were finalized. No cases from this corpus were used to tune detector thresholds or patterns.
methodology.labellingProcess: Each case was labelled by the author. TP = realistic credential matching a known provider pattern. TN = high-entropy non-secret (hash, UUID, tracking pixel, etc.)
methodology.seed: N/A — held-out corpus is deterministic (fixed strings)
methodology.reproducibilityNote: Clone the repository, run 'npm ci && npm run build && npm run benchmark:heldout'. Results are fully deterministic.
methodology.samplingLimitations: Purposive synthetic fixtures, not a random sample of production repositories. Wilson intervals below quantify binomial sampling uncertainty only and do not correct for label bias, corpus selection, or distribution shift.

independentReproduction.instructions: 1. Clone the repository. 2. Run 'npm ci'. 3. Run 'npm run build'. 4. Run 'npm run benchmark:heldout'. 5. Compare confusion-matrix counts to expectedResults above. 6. Report any discrepancy as a GitHub Issue.
independentReproduction.status: Reproduction is independent of label review. Reproducing the result does not independently validate the ground-truth labels.
